mapper.insert: insert into activity (event_name, event_type, start_time, end_time, location, organizer, description, cover_image, display_position, view_count, click_count, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{eventName}, #{eventType}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{location}, #{organizer}, #{description}, #{coverImage}, #{displayPosition}, #{viewCount}, #{clickCount}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update:
update activity
event_name = #{eventName},
event_type = #{eventType},
start_time = #{startTime},
end_time = #{endTime},
location = #{location},
organizer = #{organizer},
description = #{description},
cover_image = #{coverImage},
display_position = #{displayPosition},
view_count = #{viewCount},
click_count = #{clickCount},
status = #{status},
update_time = #{updateTime}
where event_id = #{eventId}
